name: Supermarket Income REIT Plc
source: Supermarket Income REIT plc audited consolidated statement of financial position as at 30 June 2026, Annual Report 2026, page 100 (report page 99): total assets 1,877,630, total liabilities 764,983, total equity 1,112,647, all in GBP thousands and stored here at full GBP. Ties: non-current 1,702,718 plus current 174,912 equals 1,877,630; non-current liabilities 714,037 plus current 50,946 equals 764,983; assets less liabilities equals equity 1,112,647.
note: Printed in GBP thousands, stored here in absolute pounds, which is the reporting currency of this JSE-listed secondary line. Total liabilities is the printed figure; non-current plus current liabilities equal it in both years. Capital expenditure is the acquisition of equipment, acquisition and development of investment properties and capitalised costs.
